component.name: Stand-In
component.summary: Use your big PC from here, on all your monitors

description.p: Stand-In lets a small computer anywhere in your home feel like it is plugged straight into your big PC: its screens, keyboard, mouse, pen, controllers and USB devices.
Pair with your PC once, then press Connect. Stand-In Client connects to a PC running Stand-In Server, Apollo or Sunshine.
Stand-In is built on Moonlight, the open-source game streaming client.
